name: To send from your mail
title: To send from your mail: a reply a task drafted for you to send yourself waits on the task's page, with Write it in Gmail, until you have sent it

events.opened: You pressed Write it in Gmail on a reply a task drafted for you to send
events.let_go: You pressed Not sending on a reply a task drafted for you to send

permissions: reads the replies a task drafted for you to send yourself (its sends_himself list)
writes Not sending into that list, so Sent by you stops waiting for it
tells every run to keep the draft's words in that list too
accounts: Gmail, opened in your own browser: nothing is sent by Rouh
touches.remove: Turn the switch to_send off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone from task pages and runs are no longer told to keep the draft's words; to remove it for good revert night 24's commit (rouh/to_send.py, rouh/web/to_send.py and its route in rouh/project/urls.py, its lines in rouh/objectindex.py and rouh/agent_instructions.py, the to_send act in cards.js, the tkToSend code in taskpage.js and the .osend rules in taskbrowser.css, this manifest). Words already kept in a task's list stay there.
